title: Seeding and determinism tests - same seed bit-identical, different seed different output, Re-roll distinct seed
description:
Add tests/SeedingTests.cpp covering ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md §14 item 2 (reproducibility-from-seed / D2).

Before editing, inspect:
- tests/TestMain.cpp and tests/DSPPrimitiveTests.cpp harness patterns from phase b
- Source/DSP/ShredDoubleEngine.h seed/process API
- Source/StateManager.* reroll/masterSeed if exercising Re-roll at state layer
- .abracapocus/ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md §4.10 and §14.2

Implement tests (assert-style, no new package deps):
1. Same masterSeed + identical params over two fresh engine instances / reset+seed cycles ⇒ bit-identical float output buffers (checksum or exact sample equality) for N samples after prepare.
2. Different seeds with same params ⇒ outputs differ (not bit-identical; beyond trivial float noise).
3. Re-roll path: generate/apply a new seed (engine.seed(newSeed) and/or StateManager::reroll if linkable without GUI) yields a masterSeed distinct from the previous value and changes subsequent audio vs pre-reroll seed.
4. Do not call random_device on a simulated audio thread path; if testing seed generation, call it only in the test harness/message-thread style helper.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create/modify only tests/SeedingTests.cpp. CMake registration is c.3's job.
acceptance_criteria: tests/SeedingTests.cpp asserts same masterSeed plus same params produce bit-identical engine output
tests/SeedingTests.cpp asserts different seeds produce different output under the same params
tests/SeedingTests.cpp asserts Re-roll or seed(newSeed) produces a distinct seed and changes output versus the prior seed
Tests exercise ShredDoubleEngine public seed/process APIs without introducing new third-party test frameworks
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify tests/TestMain.cpp unless absolutely required — prefer pure additional translation unit

allowed: lightweight assert helpers consistent with DSPPrimitiveTests
checksum or per-sample exact compare for bit-identity
optional StateManager hook if header is already linkable; else pure engine.seed tests
forbidden: reimplement PRNG inside the test file
require GUI/editor to validate seed determinism
